::: {.home-bio}

I am an environment and climate economist working at the intersection of **environmental economics, climate policy, and applied microeconomics**. I am currently a DPhil researcher in Geography and Environment at the [School of Geography and the Environment, University of Oxford](https://www.geog.ox.ac.uk/). My doctoral research focuses on enabling climate-compatible growth in Nepal.

My broader research interests include green growth, climate policy, environmental governance, and the economic and policy challenges of the net-zero transition, particularly in developing and emerging economies.
